notes.title: Update Base AI Model
notes.content:
I've updated the base AI model, which has nearly doubled the processing speed and reduced VRAM usage. 

In exchange, there has been a slight decrease in accuracy, but we plan to continue fine-tuning this.

notes.title: Add Shapes Control and Translation Update
notes.content:
I have updated the demo version as below;


Add Shapes Control in Main Game Scene
You can command about shapes for some operations, such as "Cut out", "Cut at angle" and so on.
Translation Update
Translation is updated. In particular, the translation of narrative text has been updated to sound more natural.
